name: nitrit0-app
description: Nitrit0 Kit: app de soporte técnico (interfaz Electron sobre los scripts del kit)

scripts.empaquetar:unico: electron-vite build && electron-builder --win portable --x64 && node poner_icono.mjs "bin-unico/win-unpacked/Nitrit0 Kit.exe"
scripts.antivirus: electron-vite build --config electron.vite.antivirus.config.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.antivirus.json --win portable --x64 && node poner_icono.mjs "bin-antivirus/win-unpacked/Nitrit0 Antivirus.exe"
scripts.clonador: electron-vite build --config electron.vite.clonador.config.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.clonador.json --win portable --x64 && node poner_icono.mjs "bin-clonador/win-unpacked/Nitrit0 Clonador.exe"
scripts.limpieza: electron-vite build --config electron.vite.limpieza.config.ts && electron-builder --config electron-builder.limpieza.json --win portable --x64 && node poner_icono.mjs "bin-limpieza/win-unpacked/Nitrit0 Limpieza.exe"
